page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred. Top to bottom: title block in several sizes of capitals and italics; author line in roman and italic; a woodcut of a bearded saint holding a key within a decorative border; publisher and place lines; date line. Handwritten ownership note at top right corner (not transcribed).

main_text.l: Apud Io. Wecheli relictam viduam, sumtibus

page.notes: Woodcut engraving of a bearded saint with key, in ornamental frame, between the author line and the place line; not transcribed. Handwritten ownership inscription at top right, not transcribed. The date line reads MDXCIII as printed (XCIII), which is transcribed here as printed. The title's line "DO-/MINICÆ:" is hyphenated across lines as printed.
